sourceMethods: Signed-in @ShizzyUnchained Grok discovery, qualitative top-five and omission reconciliation.
All 128 current subnet project pages and dated Discord-brief URLs, grouped SN-number X searches, selected official and partner originals/replies, owner bookmarks and visible History surface.
Known repository paths from current metadata and prior registry, selected commit diffs and releases; primary SEC filing and original customer/developer statements.
Finalized full-block eTAO/burn review and full prior-report lifecycle scan; owner/registration reconciliation and same-block daily owner holdings/emission estimates.
Both YouTube Videos and Live shelves plus watch-page access/duration/schedule metadata; full 128-row alpha/TAO market snapshot and sector identity check.
accessGaps: X review used all subnet-number groups, current roster/project pages and selected direct team/partner profiles; it is sampled public coverage, not an exhaustive account or private-channel census.
Discord summaries are attributed discovery sources. Original private messages, ORO account enforcement and disputed miner payouts were not independently audited; those items remain developing.

The owner’s visible X History surface exposed Bookmarks and Likes, not a complete browsing history. Saved leads were reviewed; unviewed full-length interview media and private communities remain gaps.
Some repositories were unavailable and first-page supplemental results can omit older commits. Code publication does not establish production rollout.

Burn history before October 20 depends on paginated index discovery with qualifying events independently finalized-chain verified, not a complete earlier block replay. Daily full-block event coverage ends at the stated finalized cutoff.

Provider credit usage, internal revenue accounts, paid inference and every regional wallet build were not independently tested. Grok attention is a qualitative lead list, not measured mention rankings.

decisions.reason: Reported upgrade and withholding plans are covered with the 15.65% alpha/TAO decline as timestamped context; no causal attribution or owner sale is inferred.

The 20.66% alpha/TAO rise was checked against current Ormas metadata, numbered X search, repository discovery and dated brief availability. No verified new operating catalyst was established; thin-pool/price commentary is not adoption.

The 516.13% seven-day alpha/TAO move concerns a currently unnamed slot. No new verified operating identity or launch was established; retain Unknown rather than infer a catalyst from price or annualized yield.

etao.newsDisposition: No allocation events or current-vector differences across the complete extended interval; existing verified allocation history preserved.

burns.newsDisposition: New Vanta event merged; overnight Cacheon and engy events from the prior monitor included in the full daily edition. All smaller new events retained only in underlying evidence.

ownerHoldings.ownerEmissionRates: All raw emissions and five-slot weights verified at the same holdings block; daily figures remain estimates.

registrationDeregistrationSalesReview.saleClaims: No on-chain ownership/registration change or verified sale found; equal snapshots are supplemented by the full targeted lifecycle event scan.
registrationDeregistrationSalesReview.supplementalEvidence: Final95blocks checked to same finalized daily cutoff; no lifecycle target events.

etaoReview.pendingLiveObservations: Live page reviewed: no pending differences displayed.

emissionReview.outcome: Current market leaders differ from some stale social rankings. Emission leadership alone is not new operating news.

topFive.method: Grok explicitly could not support a reliable five-subnet ranking. These are qualitative sampled lead candidates, not measured attention counts.
outcomes: Lium profiling primary added; dashboard privacy unconfirmed
BitMind recovery attributed, buy alert not adoption

leadOutcomes: SEC filing independently verified; corrected Grok framing to conditional listing, not approval.
UR timeline, Cascade direct user and Reliquary commit verified despite omission query failing to find them.
Grok absence does not overrule dated primary code or finalized chain evidence.
Beam conflicting digest attribution not promoted to confirmed rollout.

constReview.outcome: Visible October20–21 Affine, Ingot and IOTA comments were already covered or commentary; no new current-window original surfaced.

tensiaReview.outcome: Book readership promotion excluded; SN113 owner swap, SN27 metadata and earlier emission changes deduplicated against finalized archive.

ownerSourceReview.status: DONE available surfaces with history gap
ownerSourceReview.outcome: Bookmarks reviewed: Carbon interview retained pending full media review; Attune replay/Bitcast buybacks/Lium offers deduplicated or independently followed. X History exposes bookmarks/likes rather than comprehensive browsing history. No private account history published.

youtubeVerified.outcome: Latest member promoted, previous member retained, scheduled streams excluded from completed shelves; removed/postponed IDs preserved. Members-only playback cannot be independently viewed without membership access.

taostatsReview.statusReview: DONE accessible endpoint cross-check; full independent provider event reconciliation not available
taostatsReview.limitations: v1 indexed trade route works; credit usage not exposed. Primary direct finalized scan used for event truth. No per-visitor collection added.

sectorReview.outcome: All128 metadata identities reviewed; no new registration/name changes or substantiated product direction requiring a sector reassignment. Preserve multi-sector classifications and existing evidence.

mediaReview.outcome: Full original text viewed; no revenue/performance numbers inferred.
Original explicit release text viewed. Short attached app demo not independently used to assert installed functionality.
Bookmarked 79-minute interview identified; complete video not reviewed. No new sale/customer claim published from its short caption.
Member network-load allegation investigated by direct official-account search; no primary response found. Carry forward without asserting a confirmed outage.
